name: Endo
source:
Endo represents Halloween Hedonism and Happiness. He preserves the giddy joy that adults experience about the holiday: the costume parties, decorations, and "overall Halloween vibe". 

Playful, flirty, and carefree, Endo doesn't really care about his job; he just wants to have fun. 

[Edited from [url=https://hamiltonhour.itch.io/halloween-scrooge]Itch.io[/url]]
